item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】PACK - M2M Discography Collection
item.description:
I'd just like to share this down here...
So i had this quite a while back.
I had about 9 Albums here (5 Versions of "Shades Of Purple" Album and 4 Versions of "The Big Room" Album) then about 2 EPs and 11 Singles.

It's almost complete as unfortunately i can't find a FLAC copy of the Acoustic Version of "Don't Mess With My Love" so unfortunately i can't have my hands on "Everything You Do" and "Pretty Boy" Single. So if anyone has this track I'm looking for please share it to me so i could update my collection here and have it finally complete.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1S4Am73Attp9yiNN6mMW3vYcuCp2LkdFL
